effect.fr: Tenu: Quand le porteur est touché par une capacité super efficace, son Attaque et Attaque Spéciale augmentent de deux niveaux.
effect.en: Held: When the holder is hit by a super effective move, its Attack and Special Attack raise by two stages.

flavor.ko: 약점을 공격당했을 때 공격과 특수공격이 각각 크게 올라간다.
flavor.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Attack and Sp. Atk sharply increase if the holder is hit with a move it’s weak to.
flavor.ja: 弱点を つかれたとき 攻撃と 特攻が それぞれ ぐーんと あがる。
